summary.name: Quest for Duskara
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS strategy game in which you build a clay-crafted island town, raise an army, and sail to conquer fifteen archipelago cities, ending with the dark stronghold of Duskara.
use_cases: Playing a free single-player island strategy campaign on a Mac
Studying a SwiftUI and RealityKit game codebase
Learning how a city-building and army economy simulation is structured
Building the game from source in Xcode
summary.what_it_does: The game is a strategy campaign across an archipelago of fifteen island cities, where you rule one town. You place buildings such as Houses, Piers, Farms, Factories and Barracks on a 3x3 board, and upgrade each to Level 3. Daily production of gold, food and skill must cover construction, training and the food your soldiers eat. You train Archers and Knights and can attack other cities, with success depending on whether your army's strength beats the defender's garrison and defenses. Captured cities join your empire, and you can move resources between them. The page describes it as a native macOS app built with SwiftUI, RealityKit and a Metal ocean, with the source available on GitHub.
notable: Free and open source under the MIT license, built natively with SwiftUI, RealityKit and a Metal ocean
Economy where daily food supply, housing and people constrain army size
Procedurally laid-out archipelago with sea lanes linking neighbouring islands and autosaved campaigns
Trade ship offers arrive daily at the Pier
caveats: Requires building from source in Xcode; no prebuilt download is described on the page beyond the Releases page reference
